provenance.transport_note: Production was read SELECT-only through the Supabase MCP server (Management API) as role postgres, not through tools/sql-readonly.mjs. See 01-06-SUMMARY.md for the transport deviation. The RLS-bypassing service-role client was never used as the transport.

executed_sql.policies: select schemaname, tablename, policyname, permissive, roles, cmd, qual, with_check from pg_policies where schemaname in ('public','storage') order by schemaname, tablename, policyname
executed_sql.relations: select n.nspname as schema, c.relname as name, c.relkind, c.relrowsecurity as rls_enabled, c.relforcerowsecurity as rls_forced, obj_description(c.oid) as comment from pg_class c join pg_namespace n on n.oid = c.relnamespace where n.nspname in ('public','storage','cron') and c.relkind in ('r','v','m','p') order by 1,2
executed_sql.grants: select table_schema, table_name, grantee, string_agg(privilege_type, ',' order by privilege_type) as privileges from information_schema.role_table_grants where table_schema in ('public','storage') and grantee in ('anon','authenticated','service_role','postgres','public') group by 1,2,3 order by 1,2,3
executed_sql.indexes: select schemaname, tablename, indexname, indexdef from pg_indexes where schemaname = 'public' order by 1,2,3
executed_sql.columns: select table_schema, table_name, ordinal_position, column_name, data_type, udt_name, is_nullable, column_default, character_maximum_length, numeric_precision, numeric_scale, datetime_precision, is_identity, is_generated, generation_expression from information_schema.columns where table_schema in ('public') order by table_schema, table_name, ordinal_position

flag_class_definitions.rls-disabled: pg_class.relrowsecurity = false — no policy applies and access is governed only by the table grant.
flag_class_definitions.rls-enabled-no-policy: relrowsecurity = true with zero rows in pg_policies — deny-all to every non-bypassing role.
flag_class_definitions.using-true: A policy whose USING expression is the unconditional true literal.
flag_class_definitions.with-check-true: A policy whose WITH CHECK expression is the unconditional true literal — the write-side twin of using-true.
flag_class_definitions.no-to-clause: roles = {public}: the policy was written with no TO clause, so it is evaluated for every concrete role including anon.
flag_class_definitions.unindexed-policy-column: A column referenced by a policy predicate with no index covering it.
